mil3.6.6:1.2: “Venerable Nagasena, of the two—one who weeps for his mother, one who weeps out of love for the Dhamma—of the two of them as they weep, whose tears are medicine, whose tears are not medicine”?
mil3.6.6:1.3: “One person’s tears, mixed with passion and aversion, become wholly impure and hot; another’s, mixed with gladness and mental ease, become pure and cool.
mil3.6.6:1.4: What is cool, Great King, that is medicine; what is hot, that is not medicine”.
